purpose: Public immutable Arch package acquisition pins for the standalone optional PS4 diagnostic appliance.

original_repository_metadata.role: Historical external metadata input; no Omarchy checkout/source is needed.

reconstruction: Download the pinned public archives, run repo-add to generate metadata and SHA256SUMS, then put the newly measured snapshot checksum in a new/copied diagnostic profile. Metadata generation is not claimed byte-identical to the historical input.

ps4-baikal-diagnostics-dev1.dependency_validation: Names/PROVIDES from pinned metadata; pacman performs authoritative version/conflict checks when assembling the root.

ps4-baikal-diagnostics-console1.dependency_validation: Names/PROVIDES from pinned metadata; pacman performs authoritative version/conflict checks when assembling the root.

url_policy: Official Arch Linux Archive paths derived from the original package filenames; each download must match the recorded exact size and SHA256. Availability is established by acquisition, not by this source import.
